# The targeted return deliberately retains the Preserve Source selection while NR is off.
return_expected=next(r for r in rd(O/'results/expected-configurations.json') if r['label']=='baseline-return')
pinned=rd(Path(seqs[0]['manifest']['path']))['children'][0]['actual']['acquisition']['planes']
m=rd(Path(seqs[-1]['manifest']['path']));audit=[]
for c in m['children']:
 a=c['actual']['acquisition'];e=a['nrEvidence'];assert c['state']=='completed'
 source=c['actual']['source']
 assert source['fallback']=='reject' and source['kind']=='hmd_submission' and not source.get('fallbackApplied')
 assert a['sourceKind']=='hmd_submission' and a['planes']==pinned
 assert e['available'] and e['pairComplete'] and e['configuration']==return_expected['expectedConfiguration']
 assert e['configurationFingerprint']==return_expected['fingerprint'] and e['transactionId']
 assert e['configuration']['upscaling']['neuralRenderingEnabled'] is False
 assert e['configuration']['color']['settings']['mode']=='preserve_source'
 for eye in ['left','right']:
  r=e[eye]
  assert r['frame']==r['sourceWorldFrame']==a['engineFrame']
  assert r['colorRevision']==5 and r['inputEpoch']==1 and r['effectiveMode']=='preserve_source'
  assert all(r[k] is False for k in ['nrEnabled','inferenceAttempted','inferenceSucceeded','outputCommitted','applyModelEdit'])
  assert r['physicalRegions']==[] and r['disposition']=='not_requested' and r['pipelineCommitted'] is False
  art=next(x for x in c['artifacts'] if x['actual']['view']==eye+'_eye')
  p=h.committed(art,Path(seqs[-1]['manifest']['path']).parent)
  with Image.open(p) as im:assert im.format=='PNG' and im.size==(2468,2740) and im.mode=='RGB'
 audit.append({'ordinal':c['ordinal'],'engineFrame':a['engineFrame'],'passed':True,'effectiveInactiveMode':'preserve_source'})

for r in rows:
 label,eye,region,ordinal=(r[k] for k in ['label','eye','region','ordinal'])
 current=np.asarray(Image.open(O/'crops'/f'{label}-{eye}-{region}-{ordinal}.png'))
 reference=np.asarray(Image.open(O/'crops'/f'baseline-{eye}-{region}-4.png'))
 v=h.compare_pixels(current,reference)
 motion.append({'label':label,'eye':eye,'region':region,'ordinal':ordinal,'gradientSignMismatch':v['gradient_sign_mismatch'],'absoluteRgbDifference':v['absolute_rgb_error']})
summary=[]
for eye in ['left','right']:
 for label in rd(O/'plan.json')['phaseOrder']:
  rr=[r for r in rows if (r['label'],r['eye'],r['region'])==(label,eye,'face')]
  summary.append({'label':label,'eye':eye,'lumaMean':float(np.mean([r['luma_mean'] for r in rr])),'lumaRange':[min(r['luma_mean'] for r in rr),max(r['luma_mean'] for r in rr)],'edgeMean':float(np.mean([r['edge_rms'] for r in rr]))})
record=rd(next((O/'recording').glob('*.json')))
events=record.get('activityEvents',[])
menu=[x for x in events if x.get('kind')=='menu']
assert h.read_json(O/'results/nr-off-return-audit.json')==audit
h.save_json(O/'results/gradient-screen-clear-reference.json',motion)
assert h.read_json(O/'results/face-summary.json')==summary
assert h.read_json(O/'results/recording-menu-events.json')=={'keys':list(record),'events':menu}
for eye in ['left','right']:
 sheet=Image.new('RGB',(6*180,3*160),(235,235,235));draw=ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
 for ci,label in enumerate(rd(O/'plan.json')['phaseOrder']):
  for ri,region in enumerate(['floor','material','shadow']):
   ordinal=4 if label=='baseline' else 1
   p=O/'crops'/f'{label}-{eye}-{region}-{ordinal}.png'
   draw.text((ci*180+2,ri*160+2),label.replace('preserve-','')+' '+region,fill='black')
   with Image.open(p) as im:sheet.paste(im,(ci*180+2,ri*160+25))
 sheet.save(O/f'controls-contact-{eye}.png')
print(json.dumps({'offAudit':audit,'face':summary,'backgroundDeltas':[{'comparison':r['comparison'],'eye':r['eye'],'region':r['region'],'luma':r['delta']['luma_mean']} for r in rd(O/'results/deltas.json') if r['region']!='face'],'gradientMax':max(r['gradientSignMismatch'] for r in motion),'menuEvents':menu,'recordingKeys':list(record)},indent=2))

import sys,json
from pathlib import Path

W,O=map(Path,sys.argv[1:3]);sys.path.insert(0,str(W/'tools/nr-color'))
import hmd_assess as h
rows=h.read_json(O/'results/regions.json');menus=h.read_json(O/'results/recording-menu-events.json')['events']
opened=next(e['frame'] for e in menus if e['name']=='Journal Menu' and e['opening'])
closed=next(e['frame'] for e in menus if e['name']=='Journal Menu' and not e['opening'])
excluded=[{'label':'baseline','ordinal':i,'reason':'Journal Menu open at acquisition; darkened reference excluded','openFrame':opened,'closeFrame':closed} for i in sorted({r['ordinal'] for r in rows if r['label']=='baseline' and opened<=r['frame']<=closed})]
good=[r for r in rows if not(r['label']=='baseline' and opened<=r['frame']<=closed)]
ref=[];deltas=[]
for eye in ['left','right']:
 for region in ['face','material','shadow','floor']:
  old=[r for r in good if (r['label'],r['eye'],r['region'])==('baseline',eye,region)]
  new=[r for r in good if (r['label'],r['eye'],r['region'])==('baseline-return',eye,region)]
  keys=[k for k in old[0] if k not in ['label','eye','region','ordinal','frame']]
  ref.append({'eye':eye,'region':region,'baselineOrdinals':[r['ordinal'] for r in old],'baselineLumaMean':float(np.mean([r['luma_mean'] for r in old])),'clearReferenceLumaRange':[min(r['luma_mean'] for r in old+new),max(r['luma_mean'] for r in old+new)],'clearReferenceEdgeRange':[min(r['edge_rms'] for r in old+new),max(r['edge_rms'] for r in old+new)]})
  deltas.append({'eye':eye,'region':region,'delta':{k:float(np.mean([r[k] for r in new])-np.mean([r[k] for r in old])) for k in keys}})
gradient=h.read_json(O/'results/gradient-screen-clear-reference.json')
data={'excludedPairs':excluded,'retainedPairs':23,'clearReferences':ref,'offReturnAgainstClearBaseline':deltas,'primaryCounterbalancedComparisons':'All 16 Preserve Source pairs retained; one hidden-pair blink retained in whole-face primary means.','controllerAwakeRequired':False,'gradientFaceRanges':[{'label':label,'eye':eye,'min':min(r['gradientSignMismatch'] for r in gradient if (r['label'],r['eye'],r['region'])==(label,eye,'face')),'max':max(r['gradientSignMismatch'] for r in gradient if (r['label'],r['eye'],r['region'])==(label,eye,'face'))} for eye in ['left','right'] for label in ['preserve-hidden','preserve-shown','preserve-shown-return','preserve-hidden-return']]}
h.save_json(O/'results/clear-reference-audit-v2.json',data)
print(json.dumps(data,indent=2))

import sys,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(sys.argv[1]); sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
manifest=root/'SHA256SUMS.json'
assert not manifest.exists()
files=[{'path':p.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':sha(p)} for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()]
manifest.write_text(json.dumps({'schema':'csx-local-evidence-sha256-v1','files':files},indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
for item in files:
 p=root/item['path'];assert p.stat().st_size==item['bytes'] and sha(p)==item['sha256']
print(json.dumps({'files':len(files),'bytes':sum(f['bytes'] for f in files),'inventorySha256':sha(manifest),'verified':True}))
